meta_data.description:
WYSIWYG rich text editor for Bubble, built on Tiptap (tiptap.dev). Google Docs-style real-time collaboration, HTML / JSON / plain-text output, autobinding, tables, images, mentions, math, emoji and 70 element actions.

Build editors like the ones in Notion, Linear or Google Docs: markdown shortcuts, floating and bubble menus, @mentions, drag handles and live cursors.

Live demo: https://nocode-to-knowcode.bubbleapps.io/version-test/tiptap-demo
Setup guide: https://whoistyping.wtf/guides/bubble-rich-text-editor
Real-time collaboration server: https://whoistyping.wtf


WHAT YOU GET
- Text formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, subscript, superscript, highlight, text color, background color, font family, font size, line height, alignment, headings H1-H6
- Rich content: resizable images with drag & drop upload, YouTube embeds, tables (merge and split cells, header rows and columns, resizable columns), code blocks, blockquotes, horizontal rules, bullet, numbered and task lists, collapsible details sections, links, @mentions of your Bubble data, inline and block math (LaTeX), emoji
- Menus: build your own toolbar from Bubble buttons, or use the built-in bubble menu (on text selection) and floating menu (on empty lines)
- Markdown shortcuts while typing (# for a heading, > for a quote, ``` for code) plus the usual keyboard shortcuts
- Find & replace, table of contents element, character and word count, undo/redo, placeholder, max length, drag handle, invisible characters
- Output: Content (HTML), Content (JSON) and Content (Plain Text) states


REAL-TIME COLLABORATION
Several users edit the same document at once, with live cursors, names and colors. Providers: WhoIsTyping (https://whoistyping.wtf, a hosted Hocuspocus server built for this plugin, free tier; use the Custom provider), Tiptap Cloud, or Liveblocks.


HOW TO USE IT (for Bubble developers and AI agents)
1. Install the plugin and add the "Tiptap" element to a page.
2. Load content: set "Initial content" to HTML or plain text (or Tiptap JSON).
3. Save content, either way:
   - Autobinding: bind the element to a text field of a thing. Edits save after "Autobinding save delay" (default 2200 ms) and on blur.
   - Workflow: on the "Content updated" event, save the element's "Content (HTML)" state to your field.
4. Show saved content read-only: uncheck "This input is enabled".
5. Toolbar buttons: run element actions such as Bold, H2, Bullet list, Insert table, Insert image or Set link; use states such as "selection is bold" for active button styles.
6. Collaboration: check "Enable collaboration?", choose a provider, set the Doc Server ID and a unique "Document name" per document, and pass the token from the "Generate auth token" server action (Tiptap Cloud and Custom). Step-by-step: https://whoistyping.wtf/guides/bubble-collaborative-editing

Buildprint: find this plugin with `buildprint plugin search tiptap`.


Questions and feature requests: the forum thread linked above.

meta_data.plugin_instructions:
1. Add the "Tiptap" element to a page.
2. Set "Initial content" (HTML, plain text or Tiptap JSON).
3. Save the content: autobind to a text field, or save the "Content (HTML)" state when "Content updated" fires.
4. Optional: build your own toolbar with element actions, or turn on the bubble menu and floating menu.
5. Optional: real-time collaboration with WhoIsTyping (https://whoistyping.wtf), Tiptap Cloud or Liveblocks.

Demo: https://nocode-to-knowcode.bubbleapps.io/version-test/tiptap-demo
